singleSignOn.request:
Could you add Anchor+ as an OIDC client in {provider}? In Pocket ID, that’s OIDC Clients → Add OIDC Client.

- Name: Anchor+
- Callback URLs: {callbackUrl}
  and {phoneUrl} (for the phone app)
- Public client: yes, with PKCE (the phone app can’t keep a secret)

Then send me its client ID and the issuer URL (your Pocket ID’s address). Thanks!
singleSignOn.title: Single sign-on
singleSignOn.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the single sign-on settings.
singleSignOn.issuerInvalid: Enter a full URL, like https://auth.example.com.
singleSignOn.description: Let people sign in with your identity provider, like Pocket ID or Authelia (OIDC).
singleSignOn.locked: Set by OIDC_ENABLED, OIDC_ISSUER_URL and OIDC_CLIENT_ID on the server. Remove them there to change these here.
singleSignOn.enableHelp: Adds a “Continue with {provider}” button to the sign-in page.
singleSignOn.issuerNoPkce: Found {issuer}, but it doesn’t offer PKCE, which the phone app needs.
singleSignOn.issuerHelp: Your provider’s address, like https://id.example.com for Pocket ID.
singleSignOn.secretNeverShown: The saved secret is never shown.
singleSignOn.secretReplace: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.
singleSignOn.secretWebOnly: Only used for web sign-in. The phone app has its own client below.
singleSignOn.secretPublicClient: The Anchor+ phone app needs a public client, so leave this empty if people sign in from their phones, or give the phone app its own client below.
singleSignOn.secretEmptyForPhone: Leave empty for the phone app
singleSignOn.phoneClientIdHelp: For providers that give each client one sign-in method, like Logto: a public client just for the phone app, with its callback URL. Leave empty to use the client ID above.
singleSignOn.onlyHelp: Turns off sign-in and sign-up with email and password.
singleSignOn.callbackHelpSplit: In {provider}, add the first to the main client and the second to the phone app’s.
singleSignOn.callbackHelpBoth: Add both as callback URLs in {provider}.
singleSignOn.callbackHelpMore: The first is based on APP_URL. In Pocket ID, that’s OIDC Clients → Add OIDC Client; tick Public Client and PKCE so the phone app can sign in too, and copy its client ID here.
singleSignOn.requestCopied: Copied. Send it to whoever runs {provider}.
singleSignOn.copyRequest: Copy a request for your {provider} admin
singleSignOn.unsaved: You have unsaved changes to single sign-on.

otherProviders.title: More providers
otherProviders.description: Each gets its own “Continue with …” button and callback URL. People can connect one account to several.
otherProviders.idInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, up to 32 of them.
otherProviders.idHelpNew: Goes in its callback URL, so it can’t change later.
otherProviders.idHelpFixed: Can’t change, as it’s in the callback URL.
otherProviders.secretHelp: Leave empty for a public client, which the phone app can use too.
otherProviders.phoneClientIdHelp: A public client just for the phone app. Leave empty to use the client ID.
otherProviders.removeDescription: Its button leaves the sign-in page. Accounts connected to it stay connected, and sign in with it again if you add it back with the same issuer URL.
